description: The link to connect the client’s Shopify store to Rabbit, without leaving the conversation: they open it, check their store and account, then accept on Shopify. Single use, ten minutes. With no known address, the tool says to ask them for it. Returns nothing if the store is not open to their account, or if it is already connected. Use when their store isn’t connected and they need it: this link is the way to connect it.

boutique.description: Their store address in .myshopify.com, or its name (“my-store”), if the client said it.

name: connect_my_store
title: Connect my store
